objective: Computation. Two atoms in plane networks joined by rigid strips, hubs and liquid regions: whether one atom's halo, relayed along a wire, lands in the other atom's region, and whether that changes the native count or the attribution of each halo to its atom.
status: Proved by NATIVE-GENUS-20261104-001C-P001 (exact computation; the hub network by the splitting lemma): a rigid strip or a hub lands one atom's halo on a second atom's cut lines in every placement tested (13 exact on a 26-point strip network, 24 at a hub), yet each halo stays its atom's and the native count stays one piece per atom (11 of 11 separated placements), since a halo changes neither the quiet glue nor the lines the glue creates at
title: Halos carried along wires
